The evidence explicitly states that the matrix is scaled by 1/σ²(ω3). The resulting matrix S' has a diagonal element of 1 corresponding to the third eigenvalue (associated with ω3). In the context of SGGX parameterization described in the text, the diagonal elements represent the squared projected areas (or related variance metrics) along the eigenbasis directions. By scaling such that the third element becomes 1, the third eigenvalue corresponds to a unit value (unit projected area in the normalized space). The text further confirms that the roughness parameters αx and αy are derived from the ratios of the first two eigenvalues to the third (σ(ω1)/σ(ω3) and σ(ω2)/σ(ω3)), which aligns with the claim that parameters are derived from the first two relative to the third.
